---
title: "Lab 04 — Probability through simulation"
output: learnr::tutorial
runtime: shiny_prerendered
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("../R/lab_submission.R")
lab_meta <- list(id = "lab04", title = "Probability through simulation")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "A probability of 0.30 for an event means…",
  q2 = "If you repeat a small sample many times, the estimated share…",
  q3 = "P(escalation | crisis) compared with P(escalation)…",
  q4 = "Why is \"conflict is likely\" not yet a probability statement?"
)
```

## What you will do

Treat probability as a long-run share, then say what a conditional probability is not. Download the `.txt`.

```{r sim, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=5}
set.seed(4)
mean(rbinom(20, size = 1, prob = 0.30))
mean(rbinom(5000, size = 1, prob = 0.30))
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("In a long run of identical trials, the event occurs about 30% of the time.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("This particular crisis has a 30% chance of being important."),
  answer("The null hypothesis is false with probability 0.30."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Jumps around more when n = 20 than when n is large.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Equals 0.30 exactly in every sample of size 20."),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("Can be much larger. That is not, by itself, proof that crises cause escalation.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Must equal P(crisis | escalation)."),
  answer("Is an average treatment effect."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q4}
question_text(lab_prompts[["q4"]], open_answer(), trim = TRUE)
```

## Submit


```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {

      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = shiny::reactiveValuesToList(learnr::get_tutorial_state()),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
